purpose: Implement atomic file updates guaranteeing zero state corruption on failure
constraints: atomic replacement via temporary sibling rename

tasks.title: Implement SafeAtomicUpdate
tasks.context: File writes must be atomic. Failed updates must never leave broken, truncated, or partial state.
tasks.why: Prevent file corruption and race conditions across concurrent agent sessions.

references.excerpt: func SafeAtomicUpdate(targetPath string, updateFn func(old []byte) ([]byte, error)) error

decisions.chosen: Write to temp sibling in filepath.Dir then os.Rename
decisions.rationale: Same-directory temporary file guarantees atomic rename on POSIX filesystems.
rejected: os.Create in place (truncates original file before content is written)

steps.action: Read existing file data if present and record file mode
Invoke updateFn. If err != nil, abort immediately with zero disk mutation
steps.on_failure: Ensure no file write happens before updateFn succeeds

steps.action: Create temporary sibling file, write bytes, sync, close, and rename over targetPath
steps.on_failure: Verify os.Rename and defer cleanup of temp file

interfaces: func SafeAtomicUpdate(targetPath string, updateFn func(old []byte) ([]byte, error)) error
constraints: Original file must be 100% byte-preserved on updateFn error
Temp file must be removed if rename does not complete
stop_conditions: Any disk write error must clean up temp file before returning

acceptance.requirement: Successful update atomically writes new content and preserves permissions
acceptance.given: Valid target file and successful updateFn
acceptance.expected: File has updated content and identical file mode

acceptance.requirement: Failing updateFn leaves original file completely intact and deletes temp files
acceptance.given: Existing target file and updateFn that returns an error
acceptance.expected: Returns update error; original file content byte-for-byte unchanged; zero leftover temp files
